firm_data.firm_description: Fisher Phillips is an international labor and employment firm providing practical business solutions for employers’ workplace legal problems. They regularly advise and counsel clients on issues surrounding wage and hour, employment discrimination and harassment, litigation, workplace safety, immigration, trade secrets and non-competes, and more.

ai_contact.ai_notes: The new partners focus their practices on critical areas of workplace law including AI, Data and Analytics, Consumer Privacy, Global Mobility, Immigration, International Employment, Labor Relations, Litigation and Class/Collective Actions, Privacy and Cyber, Wage and Hour, Workplace Investigations, Workplace Safety and Catastrophe Management.

email.subject: AI for Fisher Phillips, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dave,

Fisher Phillips' focus on AI and data analytics across your labor and employment practices puts you ahead of most firms on recognizing where workplace law is headed. We're seeing the same shift across our partner firms.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-market practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Atlanta to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on wage and hour, investigations, and litigation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
